n = int(input())
b = int(input())
differences = []
array = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if i > 0 and evenCount == oddCount:
        differences.append(abs(array[i] - array[i - 1]))
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1

differences.sort()
totalCuts = 0
for diff in differences:
    if diff <= b:
        b -= diff
        totalCuts += 1
    else:
        break

print(totalCuts)
